info.title: ShipScope Flags — consumer API
info.description: How a service reads its flags. Contract v1: fields and their meaning never change incompatibly without a new version path (/api/v2/…); new fields may be added, so clients ignore fields they do not know. The prose version, with the recommended client behaviour, is docs/sdk-api.md; a reference client for Node.js is sdk/client.ts.

servers.description: The ShipScope Flags server, e.g. https://flags.example.com/api

get.summary: The calling service's flags in one environment
get.description: Returns only the flags assigned to the service that owns the credential, with their state in `env`. A flag missing from the answer is not (or no longer) assigned to the service: the service uses the default from its code. Every successful read is recorded as the service's check-in for `env` (at most once per 30 s). Poll at most every 60 s and keep the last good answer for when the server cannot be reached. `GET /api/sdk/flags` is the same endpoint at its pre-versioning address.

parameters.name: env
parameters.description: The environment this deployment of the service runs in.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Optional. When given, it must be the key of the service that owns the credential (else 403). With the deprecated shared SDK_TOKEN it selects the service whose flags are returned (else all flags).

200.description: The service's flags in the environment.

serviceCredential.description: The service's own credential (ssf_…), issued once in the dashboard (Services) or by POST /api/services. After a rotation the previous credential keeps working for 24 hours. The deprecated shared SDK_TOKEN is also accepted while the server sets it.

flags.description: Flag key → whether the flag is on in `env`.

message.description: A readable reason, for logs and people.

error.description: The HTTP status text, when present.

BadRequest.description: `env` is missing or not a known environment. A configuration error of the service: fix it, do not retry.

Unauthorized.description: No Authorization header, or an unknown, revoked or expired credential. Keep serving the last known state and alert: the credential needs replacing.

Forbidden.description: `service` names a service other than the credential's owner. A configuration error: drop `service` or correct it.

NotFound.description: Only with the deprecated shared SDK_TOKEN: `service` is not a registered service.

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests from one client address (600 a minute by default). Keep serving the last known state and retry after Retry-After seconds.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next request.

ServerError.description: The flag server failed (5xx). Like no answer or a timeout: keep serving the last known state and retry at the next poll.
